source: Gerado por LLM (Claude) a partir de `npm run kits -- dump` (descrições, escalas e melhorias da deadlock-api). Revise à mão e ajuste a cada patch (npm run kits -- check valida). Alvos de imbuir também são julgamento do LLM. Heróis com "archetypes" têm vários estilos de jogo; coreItems e abilityMaxPriority (slots 1–4) também são julgamento do LLM.

brawler_melee.name: Melee Brawler / Sustain

notes.health: Infernal Resilience regenerates part of the damage taken
notes.spirit_power: Siphon Life and Seismic Impact scale with spirit
notes.cooldown: Shoulder Charge (33s) is the main engage

brawler_melee.summary: Frontline tank: health, melee and sustain; spirit boosts Siphon Life and the ult.

spirit_siphon.name: Spirit Drain / Disruptor
spirit_siphon.summary: Spirit drain with a long Siphon Life and frequent engages with Shoulder Charge and Seismic Impact.

notes.spirit_power: scales Siphon Life's damage and healing per second
notes.cooldown: more engages with Shoulder Charge and Seismic Impact
notes.range: Siphon Life catches more enemies in its radius

notes.spirit_power: Itani Lo Sahn: delayed damage scales 2.6× with spirit
notes.cooldown: Sigil (12s), Riposte and Flawless Advance on a short rotation
notes.melee: Flawless Advance and Riposte fight up close and reduce melee resist

Apollo.summary: Blade duelist: short ability rotation + a spirit ult.

notes.spirit_power: Feed The Birds and Baba's Brew scale with spirit
notes.fire_rate: Threadsap: with stolen spirit, every bullet deals extra spirit damage
notes.range: Brew and Feed The Birds are area abilities

Baba.summary: Hybrid: steals spirit and turns it into bullet damage.

bomb_spirit.name: Spirit / Bomb and Hyper Beam
bomb_spirit.summary: Hook, bomb and beam: Sticky Bomb (1.5×) and Hyper Beam (2.5×) scale with spirit.

notes.spirit_power: Sticky Bomb scales 1.5× and Hyper Beam 2.5× with spirit
notes.cooldown: more hooks and bombs per fight
notes.range: Grapple Arm and the bomb from farther away

gun_uppercut.name: Gun / Hook and shoot
gun_uppercut.summary: Frontline shooter: pulls with the hook and finishes with the gun.

notes.weapon_damage: gun builds go Headhunter and Bullet Resist Shredder
notes.fire_rate: Bebop's gun gains fire rate while firing
notes.health: fights up front after the hook

notes.melee: Blasted: melee hits reload ammo and apply Wrecked
notes.health: fights in the middle of the enemy team with Chain Gang
notes.weapon_damage: Rising Ram gives +25% weapon damage on hit

Billy.summary: Bat brawler: melee feeds the gun; needs health to dive in.

notes.cooldown: Gloom Bombs (14s) and Leaping Slash (13s) cycle fast
notes.spirit_power: Gloom Bombs and Return to Shadows deal spirit damage
notes.melee: Leaping Slash scales with melee damage

Calico.summary: Burst assassin: spirit bombs + melee slash, gets in and out with Ava.

notes.spirit_power: weak gun (1.7 shots/s): the damage comes from abilities
notes.cooldown: Light Eater, Radiant Daggers and Shining Wonder depend on cooldown

notes.spirit_power: Strix Salvo, the Chimera Mk1 explosion and Close The Deal scale with spirit
notes.weapon_damage: the charged shot consumes the Strix Salvo mark; Jettison Fuel and the Chimera explosion scale with weapon damage
notes.health: Chimera Mk1 and Close The Deal damage himself
notes.cooldown: Strix Salvo (25s), Chimera Mk1 (21s) and Jettison Fuel (22s) drive the combo

Deadman Danny.summary: Hybrid air diver: marks with Strix Salvo, consumes it with the charged shot and flies in to grab a target with the ult.

notes.weapon_damage: 133 DPS gun with short damage falloff (22–27m): kills up close
notes.melee: Rend deals extra melee damage at short range
notes.mobility: Stalker's Mark and Bloodscent hunt isolated targets

Drifter.summary: Hunter of isolated targets with a strong short-range gun.

support_initiator.name: Initiator / Support

notes.cooldown: Singularity has a 250s cooldown and Rejuvenating Aurora 48s
notes.healing_power: Rejuvenating Aurora heals you and allies
notes.range: Singularity pulls everyone in its radius

support_initiator.summary: Initiator/support: the value comes from having the ult ready for fights.

gun_dynamo.name: Gun / Brawler
gun_dynamo.summary: Makes use of the gun and high health; Singularity is still the engage.

notes.fire_rate: the gun becomes the steady damage source
notes.health: stays in the fight after pulling with Singularity

notes.cooldown: Jar of Dead: the cost scales with cooldown reduction
notes.duration: Grasping Hands and Borrowed Decree (16s) last longer

Graves.summary: Summoner: summons and area denial with spirit.

notes.spirit_power: Charged Shot and Guided Owl scale with spirit
notes.weapon_damage: Rain of Arrows gives weapon damage and multishot

Grey Talon.summary: Long-range marksman, works with gun or spirit.

gun_carry.name: Gun Carry

notes.fire_rate: Bullet Dance fires your gun; the upgrade gives +10% fire rate
notes.weapon_damage: Fixation: every bullet that hits increases damage on the target
notes.ammo: a 25-round mag at 9.5 shots/s runs out fast
notes.bullet_lifesteal: Smoke Bomb gives bullet lifesteal with the upgrade

gun_carry.summary: Gun assassin: almost all the damage comes from bullets.

spirit_dagger.name: Spirit Dagger / Assassin
spirit_dagger.summary: Sleep Dagger and Smoke Bomb to catch isolated targets; the damage comes from spirit and a short Bullet Dance.

notes.spirit_power: Sleep Dagger scales with spirit and opens the combo
notes.cooldown: more Sleep Daggers per fight
notes.charges: Smoke Bomb gains charges at T2

keg_spirit.name: Spirit / Powder Keg and Crackshot
keg_spirit.summary: Spirit burst: Crackshot (1.116×) and Spirit Lasso (0.93×) with spirit, kegs on charges.

notes.spirit_power: Crackshot scales 1.116× and Spirit Lasso 0.93× with spirit
notes.mobility: Bounce Pad gets you to the keg angle

rifle_gun.name: Gun / Precision shooting
rifle_gun.summary: Precision shooter: weapon damage, range and headshots; the kit opens the fight.

notes.weapon_damage: gun builds go Headhunter and Long Range

afterburn_hybrid.name: Hybrid Afterburn

notes.fire_rate: Afterburn: every bullet hit stacks the burn
notes.spirit_power: the burn and Napalm deal spirit damage
notes.duration: Afterburn and the Flame Dash trail last longer

afterburn_hybrid.summary: Sustained damage: bullets apply a spirit burn.

spirit_napalm.name: Spirit / Napalm
spirit_napalm.summary: Napalm and Concussive Combustion as the main damage; Flame Dash to get in and out.

notes.spirit_power: Napalm and the ult scale with spirit
notes.cooldown: Napalm and Flame Dash more often per fight
notes.range: Napalm and the ult hit the whole team

thorns_spirit.name: Spirit / Entangling Thorns
thorns_spirit.summary: Spirit support: Entangling Thorns and Air Drop (0.7× spirit) control the area.

notes.spirit_power: Entangling Thorns 0.55×, Stone Form 0.6× and Air Drop 0.7× with spirit
notes.charges: Entangling Thorns gains a charge at T1

kudzu_gun.name: Gun / Kudzu Connection
kudzu_gun.summary: Gun carry: Kudzu Connection gives fire rate and bullet lifesteal to her and the ally.

notes.fire_rate: Kudzu Connection adds fire rate (scales with spirit)
notes.bullet_lifesteal: Kudzu Connection gives bullet lifesteal and shares the healing
notes.ammo: gun builds finish the magazine early (Titanic Magazine)

beam_spirit.name: Spirit / Arctic Beam
beam_spirit.summary: Spirit damage: a sustained Arctic Beam and Frost Grenade charges, Ice Path to get in and out.

notes.spirit_power: Frost Grenade (0.6×) and Arctic Beam (0.38×/s) scale with spirit
notes.duration: Arctic Beam lasts 5s and slows harder the longer it stays on target

support_grenade.name: Support / Frost Grenade and Frozen Shelter
support_grenade.summary: Healing support: Frost Grenade and Frozen Shelter heal with spirit; healing and protection items for the team.

notes.healing_power: Frost Grenade (0.8×) and Frozen Shelter heal allies
notes.cooldown: Frozen Shelter (190s) and Frost Grenade on rotation

bomb_spirit.name: Spirit / Essence Bomb
bomb_spirit.summary: Caster that trades health for damage: Essence Bomb (1.35× spirit) and Malice.

notes.spirit_power: Essence Bomb scales 1.35× and Malice 0.56× with spirit
notes.spirit_lifesteal: pays for abilities with health and recovers through damage
notes.health: Essence Bomb and Malice cost health

drain_gun.name: Gun / Life Drain
drain_gun.summary: Durable shooter: the gun deals the damage while Life Drain and health hold the trade.

notes.health: Life Drain and the extra health hold the trade
notes.charges: Life Drain gains charges at T3

notes.cooldown: Grapple (35s) → Ground Strike (18s) → Flog rotation
notes.spirit_power: Ground Strike, Flog and Death Slam scale with spirit
notes.range: Death Slam and Grapple depend on range

notes.spirit_power: turret damage scales with spirit
notes.cooldown: Mini Turret (18s) keeps several turrets on the field
notes.duration: turrets, Spectral Wall and Heavy Barrage have durations

gun_barrage.name: Gun / Fire rate
gun_barrage.summary: Fire-rate shooter: a 66-round magazine and gun items; turrets and Spectral Wall give the control.

notes.fire_rate: gun builds go Swift Striker and Fleetfoot
Love Bites: every bullet deals extra spirit damage
notes.spirit_power: Love Bites, Rake and Nox Nostra scale with spirit
notes.mobility: Sanguine Retreat to get in and out

notes.fire_rate: Djinn's Mark stacks marks with every shot
notes.weapon_damage: shots with Djinn's Mark are the main damage source

Mirage.summary: Shooter who stacks marks for burst.

notes.health: initiates from underground and holds the target with Combo
notes.cooldown: Scorn (13s) heals and deals damage on a short rotation
notes.spirit_power: Scorn and Burrow (1.5×) scale with spirit

notes.healing_power: Healing Needles heal allies with every shot (scales with spirit)
notes.ammo: Healing Needles load a full magazine of syringes
notes.cooldown: Wretched Vapors (40s) and Lurking Terrors (200s) come back faster
notes.duration: Wretched Vapors and the buffs the syringes extend last longer
notes.charges: Healing Needles gains an extra charge at T1

Nurse Harrow.summary: Gun healing support: Healing Needles heal allies, Leech Therapy drains and Lurking Terrors locks down whoever looks at her.

support_barrier.name: Support / Plot Armor
support_barrier.summary: Barrier and healing support: Plot Armor (1.5×) shields allies and Rallying Charge heals the team across the map.

notes.spirit_power: Plot Armor (1.5×) and Bookwyrm scale with spirit
notes.healing_power: Rallying Charge heals allies across the map
notes.cooldown: Bookwyrm and Plot Armor on rotation

bookwyrm_spirit.name: Spirit / Bookwyrm
bookwyrm_spirit.summary: Spirit damage: Bookwyrm and Captivating Read (1.3× each) on rotation; Bookwyrm gains charges at T2.

notes.spirit_power: Bookwyrm and Captivating Read scale 1.3× with spirit
notes.cooldown: Bookwyrm and Captivating Read on rotation

carbine_gun.name: Gun / Kinetic Carbine
carbine_gun.summary: Long-range shooter: Kinetic Carbine scales with weapon damage and the rest of the kit holds the fight.

notes.weapon_damage: Kinetic Carbine's bonus shot damage scales with bonus weapon damage
notes.weapon_range: plays from range with the Carbine and the rifle
notes.cooldown: more Kinetic Carbine shots per fight

swap_spirit.name: Spirit / Pulse Grenade
swap_spirit.summary: Control caster: Pulse Grenade, Time Wall and the Swap (1.1× spirit) decide the fight.

notes.spirit_power: Paradoxical Swap scales 1.1× and Pulse Grenade 0.3× with spirit
notes.cooldown: more grenades and Time Walls per fight

notes.spirit_power: Flying Cloak (1.3×) and Enchanter's Satchel (1.1×) scale with spirit
notes.cooldown: Satchel (17s) and Cloak (26s) are escape and damage
notes.range: Affliction and Barrage hit an area

gun_pocket.name: Close-Range Gun / Satchel
gun_pocket.summary: Short-range shotgun with Satchel and Flying Cloak to get in and out.

notes.weapon_damage: the gun does more up close, after Flying Cloak
notes.mobility: gets in and out of trades with the Satchel

notes.weapon_damage: Scrap Grenade and the ult scale with weapon damage
notes.health: Royal Pestments gives a barrier proportional to max health

Rat King.summary: Durable shooter: even the abilities scale with the gun.

notes.cooldown: Pillow Toss reduces the cooldown of the other abilities
notes.healing_power: Tag Along heals you and the ally
notes.spirit_power: Pillow Toss and Naptime (1.6×) scale with spirit

spirit_caster.name: Spirit Caster

notes.spirit_power: Lightning Ball, Static Charge and Storm Cloud scale with spirit
notes.duration: Storm Cloud is channeled and Power Surge lasts 10s
notes.range: Static Charge and Storm Cloud hit an area

spirit_caster.summary: Area caster; Power Surge allows a gun build.

gun_surge.name: Power Surge / Gun
gun_surge.summary: Power Surge turns bullets into the main damage; spirit takes a back seat.

notes.fire_rate: every bullet with Power Surge deals extra spirit damage
notes.weapon_damage: Power Surge multiplies the value of every bullet

knives_spirit.name: Spirit / Slice and Dice
knives_spirit.summary: Spirit executioner: Slice and Dice (1.2× spirit) and the knives' bleed set up the Killing Blow.

notes.spirit_power: Slice and Dice scales 1.2× with spirit, and so does the knives' bleed
notes.health: Bloodletting delays damage: more health, more margin

brawler_gun.name: Gun / Brawler
brawler_gun.summary: Gun brawler: shotgun, lifesteal and Bloodletting to hold the trade.

notes.weapon_damage: gun builds go Battle Vest and Bullet Resist Shredder
notes.health: Bloodletting delays damage: more health, more margin

notes.fire_rate: Slam Fire and Lycan Curse give extra fire rate
notes.health: Lycan Curse gains max health and more fury at low health
notes.melee: Boot Kick and the werewolf form fight up close

bolt_spirit.name: Spirit / Vexing Bolt
bolt_spirit.summary: Spirit burst: Vexing Bolt (up to 1.86×) repeated by the Assistant; the ult copies the enemy's.

notes.spirit_power: Vexing Bolt scales up to 1.86× with spirit
notes.cooldown: Audience Participation copies ults: cooldown is everything
notes.range: Vexing Bolt gains damage with distance

hex_support.name: Support / Rabbit Hex
hex_support.summary: Control support: Rabbit Hex and the Assistant, protection items for the team and copied ults.

notes.cooldown: Rabbit Hex (26s) and the copied ult on rotation
notes.duration: Spectral Assistant and Rabbit Hex last longer
notes.fire_rate: the Spectral Assistant attacks with every shot you fire

notes.cooldown: Setup Bishop (12s) and Rook Battery control an area
notes.spirit_power: pieces deal spirit damage and Kingside Knight gives a barrier

Solomon.summary: Area control strategist (less certain profile: many per-level scalings).

notes.spirit_power: Call Bell and Hotel Guest deal spirit damage
notes.range: Doorway and Luggage Cart depend on range
notes.charges: Call Bell gains a charge with the upgrade

notes.weapon_damage: Grenade, Gutshot and Ira Domini scale with weapon damage
notes.cooldown: Ira Domini (160s) executes low-health targets

Venator.summary: Pure shooter: abilities scale with weapon damage.

notes.health: Pain Battery charges by taking damage and Aura of Suffering hurts you
notes.healing_power: Pain Battery's heals scale with healing
notes.duration: Aura of Suffering is channeled for up to 8s

Victor.summary: Tank that feeds on his own damage.

notes.duration: Flight (13s) is when you deal the most damage
notes.ammo: Flight gains +50% ammo with the upgrade
notes.spirit_power: Assassinate scales with spirit

Vindicta.summary: Aerial sniper; the gun is the base, Assassinate wants spirit.

notes.spirit_power: Living Ink, Flow State, Still Life and Abstract Landscape scale with spirit
notes.cooldown: Living Ink hits reduce ability and item cooldowns; any ability recharges Flow State
notes.charges: Living Ink has 2 charges (7s between them)
notes.weapon_damage: Living Ink empowers shots (120% damage), but the gun is slow (1.5 shots/s)
notes.range: ult with an 18m radius and a 15m Flow State flick

Violet.summary: Spirit caster and support: pokes with empowered shots, stuns with Still Life and an ult that silences enemies and gives allies spirit.

notes.cooldown: Splatter, The Cube and Puddle Punch on rotation
notes.duration: Goo Ball (11s) and the Splatter puddles last longer
notes.spirit_power: Splatter and Goo Ball scale with spirit

fist_gun.name: Gun and melee / Puddle Punch
fist_gun.summary: Close-range brawler: shots, melee and Puddle Punch (scales with melee); The Cube to survive.

notes.melee: Puddle Punch scales with melee damage
notes.charges: Puddle Punch gains charges at T1
notes.health: frontline; The Cube heals and protects

notes.weapon_damage: the 94 DPS gun is the main damage source
notes.ammo: a 24-round mag at 14 shots/s runs out very fast

gun_cage.name: Gun / Binding Word
gun_cage.summary: Frontline gun fighter: Binding Word pins the target for your shots.

notes.health: frontline; Last Stand requires surviving while channeling
notes.weapon_damage: Binding Word gives +20% bullet damage on rooted targets
notes.spirit_power: Binding Word (2.4×) and Last Stand scale with spirit

flask_spirit.name: Spirit / Alchemical Flask
flask_spirit.summary: Spirit fighter: Alchemical Flask (12s) on rotation and Binding Word (2.44×); spirit also gives Warden fire rate.

notes.spirit_power: Binding Word (2.44×) and Alchemical Flask (0.63×) scale with spirit, which also gives fire rate
notes.cooldown: Alchemical Flask (12s) is the steady damage
notes.health: frontline; Last Stand requires surviving while channeling

notes.fire_rate: Full Auto increases fire rate and Card Trick makes cards with weapon damage
notes.weapon_damage: weapon damage generates the Card Trick cards

slash_spirit.name: Spirit / Power Slash
slash_spirit.summary: Spirit burst: a charged Power Slash (1.96×) and Crimson Slash to heal; the ult resets the abilities.

notes.spirit_power: Power Slash scales 1.96× with spirit
notes.cooldown: Power Slash (12s) and the ult resets abilities

gun_crimson.name: Gun and melee / Crimson Slash
gun_crimson.summary: Close-range duelist: shots and melee with Stalker and Lifestrike; Crimson Slash and Flying Slash stick to the target.

notes.melee: Flying Slash scales with melee damage
notes.weapon_damage: gun builds go Stalker and Hunter's Aura
notes.health: fights up close and heals with Crimson Slash
